subject.title: fix(qa-channel): honor canonical thread action fields

question: Should the exported QA adapter formally adopt canonical `target`/`threadName`/`message` values as higher precedence than its shipped legacy aliases when both are supplied?
rationale: The patch mechanically preserves legacy-only calls, but conflicting dual-field inputs have an externally observable adapter-contract change that needs owner acceptance rather than an automated repair.

options.title: Adopt canonical-first precedence
options.body: Approve the tested canonical-first rule so shared runner calls work consistently while legacy-only consumers continue to function.

options.title: Preserve legacy precedence
options.body: Require a revised contract that keeps legacy values authoritative when both field forms are present, accepting continued divergence from shared runner semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical-first precedence
recommendation.body: Approve the tested canonical-first rule so shared runner calls work consistently while legacy-only consumers continue to function.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this contributor as the only directly connected recent adapter contact; broader ownership provenance needs a current-main history check.
